verified.exploit_entry_point: The library's public API: postcss.parse(css, opts) and postcss(plugins).process(css, opts). Every security case drives one of them on untrusted CSS and observes the generated source map and the emitted CSS; expected values are literal markers in the case tables, never computed with the product.
sites: lib/previous-map.js:72-83 (the annotation is found anywhere in the raw CSS text, including inside strings and declaration values)
lib/previous-map.js:86-92 (loadFile reads whatever path it is given, with no confinement)
lib/previous-map.js:124-127 (the annotation branch joins the stylesheet folder and hands the result to loadFile)
lib/lazy-result.js:382 (the no-map optimisation path stringifies the root without removing an input annotation)
lib/map-generator.js:65-88 (clearAnnotation, which the fast path bypasses)
routes: T1: an annotation naming an absolute path with no stylesheet file, or a traversal path relative to the stylesheet, reads a file outside the stylesheet's folder
T10: an annotation naming a symbolic link (file or directory) that resolves outside the folder reads the target
T2: marker text inside a string or selector is treated as an annotation and loads an in-folder map
T3: with a plugin and no map option, an input annotation is emitted unchanged

T5/T4 (coupled, functional): caller-supplied map text and loaders, inline data maps, in-folder and sub-folder annotations, map.absolute and file: URL handling, and map sources outside the folder keep working
verified.project_tests_run: The project's own affected-area suites (previous-map.test.ts, map.test.ts, no-work-result.test.ts, lazy-result.test.ts, input.test.ts) with the project's native runner (uvu + ts-node, transpile-only): 101 tests on the pinned tree and 101 after the reference fix; plus 12 functional cases and 8 security cases, run on the pinned tree, the reference fix and every check patch.

traps.shape: a source-map annotation names an absolute path (no stylesheet file) or a traversal path relative to the stylesheet, so the processor reads a local file outside the stylesheet's folder
traps.reason_to_dismiss: loading the previous map named by the annotation is the documented feature, and the caller can turn it off; the same file read is what makes the feature work, so it looks intended
traps.realistic_because: published advisory route (GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q, completed by GHSA-fxqj-rqcc-2cmp) at the pinned commit

traps.shape: the annotation names a symbolic link at or below the stylesheet's folder whose target is outside it; a textual containment check sees a contained path while the read follows the link out
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the path is literally inside the folder, so a relative-path check looks complete; the fix that added the folder limit compared the textual path and left this open until a later upstream change
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code: the same bypass existed after the published A+B fixes and was fixed later upstream in 29e9e00f (8.5.26)

traps.shape: marker text that is ordinary CSS content (inside a string or a selector) is accepted as an annotation and loads an in-folder map, whose sourcesContent then reaches the output
traps.reason_to_dismiss: only a real annotation comment is supposed to count, so the extraction looks like a parser detail; the marker is user data the processor should not act on
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code: annotation extraction is a raw-text scan and current upstream still accepts marker text inside strings

traps.shape: with a plugin and no map option the processor takes its no-map optimisation path, which stringifies the root directly, so an input annotation is emitted unchanged instead of being cleared before output
traps.reason_to_dismiss: no map is produced on that path, so there is nothing to clean; the annotation is content the user wrote and the fast path is only an optimisation
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code: the no-map fast path is present at the pinned commit and current upstream still bypasses the cleaner there

traps.shape: the confinement has to stay scoped to annotation-derived untrusted paths: caller-supplied map text and loaders, inline data maps, and absolute from/to and file: URL handling must keep working, so an over-broad absolute-path or refusal rule breaks legitimate input
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the dangerous form is an absolute path, so refusing absolute paths looks like the fix; the same shapes are legitimate for the caller-supplied loader and for map output
traps.security_fail_patch: n/a: T5 is the coupled must-keep value of the confinement concept; an over-broad fix is proved wrong by checks/overbroad.patch (functional_fail)
traps.realistic_because: the project's own fixtures require caller-supplied maps and file: URL output to keep working (test/previous-map.test.ts:224-267, test/map.test.ts:607-652)

traps.shape: map sources legitimately point outside the stylesheet's folder and must keep being resolved for error reporting; a confinement rule applied to map metadata instead of the file read breaks that
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the same containment idea seems to apply to every path the map mentions, so confining sources as well looks consistent; it is over-hardening
traps.security_fail_patch: n/a: T4 is the coupled must-keep value of the confinement concept; over-hardening it is proved wrong by checks/overbroad.patch and by the project's own origin tests
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code: origin resolves map sources and sourceRoot to URLs and paths, and the project's fixtures require sources outside the folder

patch_checks.why: fresh agent (deepseek-flash[1m]), full view (instruction, tree, tests, reference, trap list)

wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: a throw aborts the case before the protected outcome is observed; the security cases require a normal result (or a clean refusal that carries no file contents), and the functional cases require legitimate maps to keep loading
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: the surface has one direction (untrusted CSS in, CSS and map out) and no roles or peers
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the operation is a read-only lookup; there is no write or verb split to guard
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: no authority, allowlist or role service is consulted

A.summary: arbitrary file read and information disclosure through an attacker-controlled sourceMappingURL annotation

B.summary: incomplete fix of GHSA-6g55-p6wh-862q: the containment check was skipped when the stylesheet had no file, leaving traversal and absolute .map reads open

history.pinned_rule: first parent of A's first fix commit aaec7b78b3ce (verified with git rev-parse in the pinned clone); the containment check that B completes was introduced in 95663d3e (8.5.18), so the combined upstream patch is the lib/previous-map.js state at 7beca139
history.extra_fixes_beyond_published: the symbolic-link bypass (T10) was fixed upstream later in 29e9e00f (8.5.26), outside the two advisories' fix commits; it is an uncovered route into the same read
